name: manual_dd15b5
claim: Strangler-fig migration pattern: for long-term migration, use HTTP-only adapter (never import internal modules). For one-time OS setup, apply patches to the installed binary. These are complementary, not competing. PT adapter calls patched binary via CLI/HTTP; orama applies OS-level patches once at install time.

decisions.notes: Mined from PT/docs/MIGRATION.md Tension 1 + orama-system/docs/2026-05-14--UNIFIED-ABSORPTION-PLAN.md §6. setup_macos.py = patch binary once; packages/alphaclaw-adapter/ = ongoing lifecycle.
